intro: Role-conditioned qualification gates for the self-assessment demo. Gates with min_grade_order above the learner's grade_order are hidden. aligns_with_cluster mirrors role-mapping clusterRelevance where possible.

AI.label: Working with AI
AI.blurb: Tools, literacy, opportunities, and — where relevant — governance.

gates.prompt: Do you use or encounter AI in your work?

prompt_by_grade.AA_AO: Do you use AI tools (for example Copilot or chat assistants) in your day-to-day casework or admin?
prompt_by_grade.EO: Do you use or encounter AI tools in your team’s day-to-day work?
prompt_by_grade.G7: How central is AI to the work you lead or commission?
prompt_by_grade.G6: How central is AI to the work you lead or commission?
prompt_by_grade.SCS: How central is AI to the outcomes you are accountable for?

gates.prompt: What sort of things do you use AI for?
gates.placeholder: e.g. drafting briefings with Copilot, exploring use-cases, reviewing AI-generated summaries…

gates.prompt: Do you help colleagues use AI well (coaching, standards in your team)?
Are you responsible for AI policy, assurance, or compliance?

Digital.label: Digital tools and services
Digital.blurb: Everyday tools, accessible content, and digital ways of working.

gates.prompt: How much of your work depends on digital tools and systems?

options.label: I shape how digital work is done

gates.prompt: Which tools or digital tasks matter most in your role?
gates.placeholder: e.g. casework systems, Microsoft 365, creating documents, collaborating online…

gates.prompt: Do you help design or improve digital services for users?
Do you lead digital capability or transformation for a team or wider area?

Data.label: Working with data
Data.blurb: Literacy, quality, analysis, and sharing data responsibly.

gates.prompt: How often do you work with data in your role?
What kind of data work do you do?
gates.placeholder: e.g. updating records, reading dashboards, producing spreadsheets, briefing from analysis…

gates.prompt: Do you analyse data or use analysis to support decisions?
Do you share or govern data across teams or organisations?

Innovation.label: Innovation and improvement
Innovation.blurb: Conditions for change, problem framing, testing ideas, and making change stick.

gates.prompt: How often are you involved in improving how work is done?

options.label: Occasionally suggest or try small changes
Innovation / change is core to my role

gates.prompt: What kinds of improvement or innovation work have you been part of?
gates.placeholder: e.g. process tweaks, pilots, workshops, storytelling about change…

gates.prompt: Do you test ideas, prototype, or run innovation projects?
Are you responsible for embedding or scaling change beyond your team?
